fields.name: enabled
docs: The flag, if admin set enable = false, then the user can only withdraw and cannot deposit in the vault.

fields.name: bumps
docs: Vault nonce, to create vault seeds

fields.name: totalAmount
docs: The total liquidity of the vault, including remaining tokens in token_vault and the liquidity in all strategies.

fields.name: tokenVault
docs: Token account, hold liquidity in vault reserve

fields.name: feeVault
docs: Hold lp token of vault, each time rebalance crank is called, vault calculate performance fee and mint corresponding lp token amount to fee_vault. fee_vault is owned by treasury address

fields.name: strategies
docs: The list of strategy addresses that vault supports, vault can support up to MAX_STRATEGY strategies at the same time.

fields.name: base
docs: The base address to create vault seeds

fields.name: operator
docs: Person who can send the crank. Operator can only send liquidity to strategies that admin defined, and claim reward to account of treasury address

fields.name: reserve
docs: Lending pool address, that the strategy will deposit/withdraw balance

fields.name: collateralVault
docs: The token account, that holds the collateral token

fields.name: currentLiquidity
docs: The liquidity in strategy at the time vault deposit/withdraw from a lending protocol

fields.name: bumps
docs: Hold some bumps, in case the strategy needs to use other seeds to sign a CPI call.

fields.name: vault
docs: Vault address, that the strategy belongs

fields.name: isDisable
docs: If we remove strategy by remove_strategy2 endpoint, this account will be never added again

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} creates vault ${accounts.vault} for ${accounts.tokenMint}, with LP mint ${accounts.lpMint}

instructions.name: initializeStrategy
docs: Initialize a strategy and add strategy to vault.strategies index

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} creates strategy ${accounts.strategy} of vault ${accounts.vault}, of type ${data.strategyType}, lending to reserve ${accounts.reserve}

instructions.name: removeStrategy2
docs: remove a strategy by advance payment

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.operator} moves ${data.amount} of the tokens of vault ${accounts.vault} into strategy ${accounts.strategy}

docs: The accounts the strategy's lending protocol needs for the deposit or withdrawal, in the order that protocol takes them; they differ from one lending protocol to another.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.operator} moves ${data.amount} out of strategy ${accounts.strategy} back into vault ${accounts.vault}

docs: The accounts the strategy's lending protocol needs for the deposit or withdrawal, in the order that protocol takes them; they differ from one lending protocol to another.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} deposits ${data.tokenAmount} from ${accounts.userToken} into vault ${accounts.vault} for at least ${data.minimumLpTokenAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint}, to ${accounts.userLp}
${accounts.user} burns ${data.unmintAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} from ${accounts.userLp} to withdraw at least ${data.minOutAmount} from vault ${accounts.vault} into ${accounts.userToken}

instructions.name: withdrawDirectlyFromStrategy
docs: user withdraw liquidity from vault, if vault reserve doesn't have enough liquidity, it will withdraw from the strategy firstly

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} burns ${data.unmintAmount} of LP token ${accounts.lpMint} from ${accounts.userLp} to withdraw at least ${data.minOutAmount} from strategy ${accounts.strategy} of vault ${accounts.vault} into ${accounts.userToken}

docs: The accounts the strategy's lending protocol needs for the deposit or withdrawal, in the order that protocol takes them; they differ from one lending protocol to another.

fields.name: otherBumps
docs: Bumps of PDAs for the integrated protocol.

fields.name: lastUpdatedLockedProfit
docs: The total locked profit from the last report
